The gain for the Gaussian PSF with sigma 2 and lambda 0.01. With the identity it equals the Wiener gain with K = 0.01. The gradient penalty is 0 at frequency 0, so the mean brightness is kept exactly, and it grows with frequency, so high frequencies are held back more.
